sources.note: Village of Hyde Park: Annual Village Meeting summary, May 5, 2026, Article 4 elects a trustee for the two-year term ending 2028 but prints the winner's name blank. Amy O'Toole held the only two-year trustee seat expiring in 2026, and the trustees' minutes of June 4, 2026 and five later 2026 sets list her as a sitting trustee, with no vacancy appointment recorded; she is minted elected on this identification by elimination, disclosed here and on issue #163.
